lounges.name: Ethiopian Airlines Sheba Cloud Nine Lounge
lounges.location: Airside opposite Gate A13; connecting passengers go up to the departure floor after transfer security.

sources.title: Ethiopian Airlines · Addis Ababa lounge access and facilities

lounges.note: An incoming Business ticket does not qualify when the onward flight is Economy. Entry starts five hours before departure; confirm the estimated time if delayed. Showers require registration with at least an hour before departure and have a 15-minute limit.

qualityRating.summary: An August 2026 review found ample comfortable seating, decent food and a quieter rear section, but many bars and food stations were unstaffed. A solid stop with uneven use of its large space.

sources.title: Points to Seats · Cloud Nine Terminal 2 review

lounges.name: Ethiopian Airlines Star Alliance Gold Lounge
lounges.location: Airside opposite Gate A13; follow signs for Star Alliance Gold, not the separate ShebaMiles Platinum or Silver lounges.

accessRules.label: Star Alliance Gold on a Star Alliance departure

sources.title: Ethiopian Airlines · Addis Ababa lounge access and facilities

lounges.note: Separate status access from Cloud Nine cabin access. Entry starts five hours before departure; confirm estimated timing if delayed. Shower registration requires at least an hour before departure, with a 15-minute session limit. No independent rating has yet been established for this specific Gold section.
